rows.question: Which of the three segments—SME, LAM and KAM—has the biggest and lowest percentage increases in consumption paid in EUR between 2012 and 2013?

samples.sql:
SELECT c.Segment,
       SUM(CASE WHEN y.Date LIKE '2013%' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013,
       SUM(CASE WHEN y.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
       (SUM(CASE WHEN y.Date LIKE '2013%' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN y.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN y.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS pct_increase
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  AND (y.Date LIKE '2012%' OR y.Date LIKE '2013%')
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC;

SELECT c.Segment,
       (SUM(CASE WHEN y.Date LIKE '2013%' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN y.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN y.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS pct_increase
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND c.Segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM')
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC;

SELECT c.Segment,
       (SUM(CASE WHEN y.Date LIKE '2013%' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN y.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN y.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS pct_increase
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND c.Segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM')
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC;

SELECT c.Segment,
       SUM(CASE WHEN y.Date LIKE '2013%' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013,
       SUM(CASE WHEN y.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
       (SUM(CASE WHEN y.Date LIKE '2013%' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN y.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN y.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS pct_increase
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND c.Segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM')
GROUP BY c.Segment

SELECT c.Segment,

FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')

rows.question: How much faster in percentage is the champion than the driver who finished the race last in the 2008 Australian Grand Prix?

FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE ra.year = 2008 AND ra.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
  AND r.milliseconds IS NOT NULL;

FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE ra.year = 2008 AND ra.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
  AND r.milliseconds IS NOT NULL;

SELECT 
  ROUND(
    (MAX(CASE WHEN ds.position = (SELECT MAX(position) FROM driverStandings WHERE raceId = r.raceId) THEN ds.points END) 
     - MAX(CASE WHEN ds.position = 1 THEN ds.points END)) 
    / MAX(CASE WHEN ds.position = 1 THEN ds.points END) * 100, 2
  ) AS percentage_faster
FROM races r
JOIN driverStandings ds ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.year = 2008 AND r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix';

    (MAX(CASE WHEN ds.position = (SELECT MAX(position) FROM driverStandings WHERE raceId = r.raceId) THEN ds.points END)

FROM races r

WHERE r.year = 2008 AND r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix';

rows.question: List the names of virtual schools that are among the top 5 in their respective counties based on average reading scores.

FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
  AND sc.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM satscores AS sc2
